component.name: Omadungeon
component.summary: Procedural rogue-like skinned by your Omarchy theme

description.p: A fast, room-based rogue-like dungeon crawler. The palette, lighting and level generation are derived from the Omarchy theme and wallpaper you are running, and the dungeon retints live when you switch themes. Four classes, procedural loot, two active and two passive ability slots, and enemies who all dislike your setup.
